snippet.title: Crimson Frontier: Youth —Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
We’re excited to announce our new game Crimson Frontier: Youth.

In this choice-driven sci-fi visual novel, you play as Adam Crimson — the son of a military captain, raised under strict discipline where powerful corporations are fighting for control and a Resistance is beginning to rise.

Will you follow your father’s path — or choose your own?
